questions.questionText: Which of the following is the most suitable title for the passage?
options: Reading the Sky: Forecasts and the Farmer
The History of the Western Ghats
How Markets React to April Outlooks
questions.explanation: The passage is about how forecasts reach and serve farmers. The other titles are too narrow or not supported (it never says supercomputers cannot predict rain).

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the most appropriate title for the passage?
options: Scan and Pay: The Promise and the Gaps of UPI
questions.explanation: The passage covers both the benefits of UPI and the remaining gaps. Fraud, card machines or one seller are narrow parts of it.

questions.questionText: The most suitable title for the passage is
options: From Village Ground to Prime Time
questions.explanation: The passage traces kabaddi's move from village grounds to televised league. The others are narrow or unsupported.

questions.questionText: Which title best suits the passage?
options: Millets: The Return of the Poor Man's Grain
Why Rice Fails in Dry Land
questions.explanation: The passage covers decline, health value, official buying and farm economics of millets. The others are details.

questions.questionText: The most appropriate title for the passage is
options: Links in a Chain: Bengaluru's Vanishing Lakes
The History of Tank Building on the Deccan
questions.explanation: The title should capture both the lost lake network and its link to floods. History of tank building alone is too narrow.

questions.questionText: Which title best expresses the theme of the passage?
options: The Loom and the Livelihood: Handloom Weaving Under Pressure
questions.explanation: The passage covers the effort of weaving, competition from power looms and the young leaving the trade.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the best title for the passage?
options: Doctor on the Screen: Telemedicine in Remote India
questions.explanation: The title must cover the uses, limits and needs of telemedicine in remote places.

questions.questionText: Which title would best suit the passage on coaching institutes and the Kota dream?
options: Chasing Ranks: The Price of the Kota Dream
The Economy of Hostels and Tiffin Services
questions.explanation: The passage is about the pressure created by the race for ranks in Kota.
